北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，气温 31℃ 稍热，记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and bright, with temperatures around 31℃. Remember to protect yourself from the sun and hydrate!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，气温 32℃，体感闷热，多喝水，注意防暑哦！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy at 32℃, feeling muggy. Drink plenty of water and prevent heatstroke!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴空万里，体感 33℃，户外活动别忘防暑和补水！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai enjoys clear skies, feeling like 33℃. Don't forget heat protection and hydration for outdoor activities!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 37℃ 炎热，多云天气也防晒，多喝水防中暑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels a hot 37℃, cloudy but sunny. Protect from sun and drink water to prevent heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云炎热，体感 36℃，风力 5级，注意防暑防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and hot, feeling like 36℃ with 5-level winds. Mind heat and sun protection!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云炎热，气温 33℃，午后易疲惫，注意休息补水！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and hot at 33℃. You might feel tired in the afternoon, remember to rest and hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云炎热，气温 32℃，湿度大，记得随时补充水分哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and hot at 32℃ with high humidity. Remember to stay hydrated at all times!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天湿度大，体感 30℃，出门带伞，注意防潮！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with high humidity, feeling like 30℃. Bring an umbrella and mind the moisture!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天闷热，体感 36℃，记得多喝水，防范中暑！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and muggy, feeling like 36℃. Remember to drink plenty of water and prevent heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 33℃ 略显闷热，出行别忘多补充水分！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feeling a bit muggy at 33℃. Don't forget to hydrate well when out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 66%，闷热注意防暑降温！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feeling 30℃ with 66% humidity. It's muggy, so mind heatstroke prevention and cooling!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 30℃，注意防晒，户外活动别太久哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feeling 30℃. Mind sun protection, and don't stay outdoors too long!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 35℃ 炎热，请多补充水分，防晒很重要！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feeling a hot 35℃. Please drink plenty of water, sun protection is crucial!

昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天凉爽，气温 22℃，湿度大，出门带伞添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and cool at 22℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and add a layer!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 31℃，风力 6级，海边出行注意防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy at 31℃ with 6-level winds. Be mindful of strong winds if heading to the beach!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛

大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feeling around 30℃. The weather is muggy, don't forget to hydrate well!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云，气温 31℃，风力 5级，注意防风防晒，及时补水！

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗炎热，气温 32℃，出行注意防晒，及时补充水分！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and hot with temperatures at 32℃. Protect yourself from the sun and hydrate promptly!
